name: Mowzie's Mobs 1.7.2
changelog:
+ Boulders now have smaller hitboxes while travelling to avoid unwanted collision with terrain
+ Largest geomancy boulder passes through enemies instead of breaking on hit.
+ Players now leave glowing footprints when they have the sun's blessing.
+ Added an indicator particle that points to blocks obstructing Sculptor's test
Fixed geomancy boulders and bluffs destroying items
Fixed bluff crash
Updated some translations
Added effect descriptions
Fixed item duplication bug in Umvuthi and Sculptor trade menus
Fixed Abavuthana only trading for exact stack counts
Fixed particles turning black while items are being picked up
Fixed missing Wroughtnaut subtitle
Fixed bosses being pushed by pistons
Fixed raked sand not being placeable above empty blocks

name: Mowzie's Mobs 1.6.5
changelog:
- Fix nagas stuck in water
- Fix suns blessing duration resetting on ability use
- Fix crash rendering umvuthi
- Added config option for crane sounds for players who crash during the healing magic
- Added config option for the maximum number of umvuthana followers the sol visage can summon at once
- Removed the geckolib mixin, resolving numerous incompatibility issues
- Fix other crash related to crane sound effects
- Config option to disable umvuthana footprints
- Fix sunstrike rendering crash
- Fix Umvuthi losing his target when losing line of sight
- Fix incorrect loot condition types
- Fix spear item breaking blocks in creative mode
- Fix wooden blocks not working as furnace fuel
- Fix clawed logs not being smeltable into charcoal
- Fix Umvuthana UI name text not being colorable (I suspect)
- Added a cooldown to Umvuthi's hurt animation to prevent him from getting stuck
- Magic effects can now hit nonliving entities like End Crystals
- Decreased default naga spawn rate slightly
